[Act: cpc
 Chapter: Issue and service of summons
 Section: O5R6::Fixing day for appearance of defendant.
]


The day 2[under sub-rule (1) of rule 1] shall be fixed with reference to the current business of the Court, the place of residence of the defendant and the time necessary for the service of the summons; and the day shall be so fixed as to allow the defendant sufficient time to enable him to appear and answer on such day.

metadata.section_title: Fixing day for appearance of defendant.
